popCulture.title: Labours of Hercules
popCulture.description: Lion, Hydra, Hind, Boar, Stables, Birds, Bull, Mares, Belt, Cattle, Apples, Cerberus — the twelve deeds that made Heracles immortal.

popCulture.title: Heracles
popCulture.description: The labours are the hero's public face — every vase, statue, and film returns to Eurystheus' impossible list.
